patthana17.13:1.1: Akusalaṃ hīnaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca naakusalo nahīno dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana17.13:2.1: Abyākataṃ majjhimaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā naabyākato namajjhimo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
patthana17.13:3.1: Kusalaṃ paṇītaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nakusalo napaṇīto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā cha.
